description: Add, remove, enable, or disable a firewall mangle rule. ruleAction sets the action; when it is omitted, a new* value implies its own (newRoutingMark → mark-routing), otherwise accept. Each new* value is accepted only under its action. Uses comment as idempotency key: a repeated add returns already_exists only when the chain, match fields, marks, DSCP, MSS, passthrough, and the given or implied action agree, otherwise CONFLICT. Supports dry-run mode.

chain.description: Mangle chain (required on add): prerouting, input, forward, output, postrouting

comment.description: Idempotency key — uniquely identifies this mangle rule

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dstAddressList.description: Destination address list name to match

newMss.description: MSS to set: a number or clamp-to-pmtu (ruleAction change-mss, with protocol tcp and tcpFlags syn)

newRoutingMark.description: Routing mark to set (ruleAction mark-routing, chain prerouting or output)

passthrough.description: Whether to continue matching subsequent rules

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

ruleAction.description: Mangle action, add only. Omitted: the action of the new* value given (newRoutingMark → mark-routing, newConnectionMark → mark-connection, newPacketMark → mark-packet, newDscpValue → change-dscp, newMss → change-mss), else accept, the RouterOS default

srcAddressList.description: Source address list name to match

tcpFlags.description: TCP flags to match, comma-separated, ! negates one (e.g. "syn"); needs protocol tcp

name: manage_mangle_rule
title: Manage Mangle Rule
